text:
ada: Heads up — deploy-bot auto-paused the promotion. Staging canaries are failing during artifact push; multipart uploads are stalling and registry returning slow_downs.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_upload_throttle).

logs:
```
uploader: chunk write timeout after 26s
registry: 503 slow_down x 31
cache-mirror: semaphore wait > 10s, queue depth 620
```

omar: Seen this pattern before — cache semaphore starvation when many small chunks hit the same shard. Short-term options: 1) reduce multipart concurrency, 2) switch to fallback registry endpoint, 3) pin to last-good image and rerun.

sophie: Change window in ~25m. I prefer pin+rerun to avoid a rollback during the window. We'll document the pin in release notes and follow up with infra.

ada: Agree. Opening a promo-pin and queuing a retry with concurrency=3. Pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2905550001  pinned sha256:3a9d1b2c. Note: "manual pin due to artifact upload semaphore starvation / registry slow_downs".

ci-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image: pipeline #5123 (staged).

infra-oncall: Investigating cache-shard hotspots. Temporarily scaling shard group and bumping semaphore limit. Collecting uploader traces and shard metrics. ETA ~8m.

omar: Adding checklist to the ticket: uploader chunk traces, shard semaphore waits (P50/P95/P99), registry 503 counts, deploy-bot backpressure counters.

sophie: I'll update release notes: "Promo held - pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact upload saturation; infra investigating shard semaphore contention." Marking cut as "held - pinned" on the tracker. If infra stabilizes inside window we unpin and proceed; otherwise move promo to next change window.

ada: Holding for infra update. Posting status to #release-updates.
